objective: Iterate the infinite-width recursion for the rank distribution of layered random monotone circuits and simulate finite widths exactly to large depth; fit the growth of the mean and the largest rank against frozen predictions; try to derive the asymptotics.
status: Supported 2026-11-17 (referee pending): exact identity Q' = Q - q^2/2 at infinite width (proved); recursion to 10^5 confirms the Burgers law, mean ~ (2/3)sqrt(L) - ln(L)/4, L F(1) -> 4, L F(2) -> 10.47; largest of 1,024 within one of SEQUENTIAL-WALL's 4..17; 10 of 11 predictions held (S2 failed at d = 4096: 142.5 > 130).
title: Strahler numbers of layered random circuits: recursion and simulation
